sloka: ततो हलहलाशब्दः सर्वदिग्भ्यः समुत्थितः ।धर्मराजस्य योधानां शूराणां सम्प्रधावताम् ।। ७.२१.२५ ॥
transliteration: tato halahalāśabdaḥ sarvadigbhyaḥ samutthitaḥ ।dharmarājasya yodhānāṁ śūrāṇāṁ sampradhāvatām ।। 7.21.25 ॥

translations.english: Then, a great tumultuous roar arose from all directions, made by the brave warriors of Yama who were charging forward.
